articles.summary: DineSafe recently had the opportunity to take part in New Food’s webinar, "Food Tech, Digital Transformation & AI," held on March 25, 2025, at 3 PM GMT. This event brought together leading experts in food safety and technology to discuss the evolving role of artificial intelligence, automation, and cybersecurity in the food industry.
articles.title: DineSafe Attends the New Food Webinar: Food Tech, Digital Transformation & AI
